data.name: Asheesh
data.gender_notes: Asheesh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Asheesh is a Sanskrit name derived from the Sanskrit word ‘ashī’ meaning 'wisdom'. This name is a tribute to the God of Wisdom, Lord Buddha, and is believed to bestow the bearer with intelligence and knowledge. In Hindu mythology, Asheesh is also identified with Lord Vishnu, who is revered as the embodiment of wisdom and knowledge.
data.etymology: Asheesh belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Wise, Intelligent.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Asheesh total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
